prompt:
Image 1 is a finished painted game cutout of a treant whose drawing is right: keep exactly its camera (high above and behind, looking down at about 40 degrees, orthographic), the direction it faces, its pose, its body's outline (the trunk, the two branch arms and the two root-legs), its size and position in the image, its light and the flat pure magenta background. This is a plain re-dress of the same body: repaint its bark, its face and its crown as the treant of Image 2, and change the outline only where Image 2's crown or the top of its trunk is a different shape.

Image 2 is the approved painted portrait of the treant to paint: the same kind of tree, the same bark, face, crown, colours and marks, now seen full body from above, in the same painting style. Do not copy its dark background, its candlelight or its head-and-shoulders framing.

One large painted creature, full body, alone on a perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, as a game cutout. Pose: exactly the pose of Image 1.

Camera: high above and behind, looking down at about 40 degrees, the way a player looks down at a miniature on a table; orthographic, no perspective. The treant faces away from us, toward the upper right of the image: we see its back, its right side and the top of its head from behind. It is foreshortened as seen from above: its back and head large, its legs short.

The creature: a Treant, the walking tree of the reference portrait, summoned by Thornwood druids (size 4, about three and a half men tall): its trunk is its body and head, two long branch arms ending in knotted twig fingers, two short stumpy legs that splay into roots; its face is in the bark near the top of the trunk. It is a scarred treant in its prime, part of a split oak trunk: long, angular, rough dark-brown oak bark; a jutting burl for a nose, a wide mouth that is a deep horizontal crack in the bark, two dark knothole eyes deep in the bark, one narrowed by a blackened lightning scar that runs from the crown down across one cheek; a stern look; no beard, the jaw bare bark with a few short root tendrils. Its marks, every one painted clearly: a crown of bare, twisted, thorny black branches; ivy wound around the trunk; a blackened lightning scar from the crown down across one cheek; rough dark-brown oak bark. The crown of bare twisted thorny black branches, the ivy wound around the trunk and the dark oak bark show from behind and above; its face is hidden.

Remove from Image 1 what belongs to the other treant: the alder's grey-green mossy bark, its budding twig crown with pale-green leaves and the fern fronds of Image 1. None of them may remain.

Body shape, seen from behind: the trunk runs straight down, as thick as a tree trunk, from the shoulders into the two root-legs, with no rounded rump, no buttocks and no swelling hips: the lower back is flat furrowed bark that divides at the knees into the root-legs, the way an old tree divides into roots; never a human backside.

Light: outdoor daylight. A high sun in the upper left of the image lights the top and the upper-left side of the treant with warm highlights; a cool blue-grey sky fill lies in the shadows on the lower-right side. No candlelight, no dramatic dark shadows, nothing glows unless the description says so. No cast shadow on the background.

Painting style: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, moderate detail, the same hand as the painted portrait reference; a muted earthy palette with the treant's own colours exactly as its portrait shows them; soft painterly edges, small crisp highlights and a thin bright rim of light along the upper-left edges. A strong, simple, readable silhouette that still reads when shrunk to 190 pixels. It is not a cartoon: no cel shading, no thick black outlines, no chibi or big-headed proportions, no glossy 3D render, no pixel art.

Size: the creature fills the image as in Image 1, centred, with at least 24 pixels of clean background all around.

Background: one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor, vignette or shadow. No pink, magenta, violet or purple anywhere on the creature.

Never: text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, borders, frames, signatures, logos; a floor, ground, scenery or cast shadows; blood; other creatures or people; a cropped treant.
